description: Independent next-sprint VEILBOUND coding work. These are design goals, not confirmed defects.

tasks.goal: Correct objective counters so completed objectives never display overflow such as 3/2; verify lock-on target acquisition and combat state invariants in WorldState.
Improve sword swing phases, fluid forward attack arc and clear impact timing while preserving dodge, idle and stamina behavior in CombatMotion and CharacterRig.
Improve hero and enemy silhouettes, armor layering, hands and boots, and reduce blocky geometry with efficient deterministic mesh structures.
Add controlled roughness, metal and leather detail and more believable material sampling within native GLES2 texture and atlas budgets.
Improve flagstone and ruins geometry variation, terrain details and static asset batching without increasing runtime mesh regeneration.
Refine the Model Atelier asset registry, camera framing and orbit controls with testable, stable real-emulator navigation.
